maya: quick design check — we switched the models grid to a "snap" keyboard flow (Tab/Shift-Tab jumps to closest column). worried about screen reader verbosity + focus ring jitter when the visual layout reflows. thoughts? :eyes: jordan: can you paste the markup? is each card a button or link? maya: each card is a button (click opens details). DOM is row-major. visual layout uses CSS grid with responsive columns. no hidden focusables. eli: role=grid + role=row + role=gridcell is ok for 2D nav, but screen readers expect Arrow keys for movement. Using Tab to snap across columns will confuse SR users. dena: from our usability sessions — keyboard-only folks expect either strict linear Tab or 2D Arrow nav. mixing both causes loss of context. recommendation: keep Tab to enter/exit the grid, support Arrow keys for intra-grid moves. jordan: ok I'll prototype roving tabindex + arrow handlers. to reduce announcement spam, debounce aria-live updates. eli: suggested SR announcement: "Model: , card of , status ". add aria-posinset and aria-setsize on gridcell so some AT will announce position. add aria-label for status icon. jordan: sample snippet to try: ```
``` maya: also — focus ring seems to jump because we change CSS transforms during layout. idea: keep element in-flow, use subtle box-shadow outline instead of transform on focus. reduced perceived jump in prototype. eli: agree. focus outline on dark theme currently fails 3:1. use at least 4.5:1 for interactive focus. a11y-bot: automated scan: "focus-outline-dark-theme.png" flagged; rule: focus contrast < 4.5. Created issue #A11Y-482. jordan: will update CSS tokens and implement roving tabindex + arrow key handlers. will post demo later today. :thumbsup: maya: one last nit on aria-live copy — avoid verbose timestamps. keep it to name + index + status. less is better for SR users. dena: also add a tooltip for hover with keyboard hint: "Arrow keys to move, Enter to open" — helps discoverability. jordan: noted. prototyping now, will ping when demo is up.
